facts.t: The 100 percent checklist counts 277 discoverable vehicles in total
The checklist tracks 255 animal entries across Leonida
The full challenge list runs to 80 challenges, beyond the 50 the trophy requires
There are 300 stunt locations on the checklist, while the stunt trophy itself pops at 250
The 100 percent list asks for 15 meditations, while the meditation trophy tracks all 18 spots
Leonida is divided into 52 explorable areas on the official list
Nine gangs each hold at least one illegal operation that can be robbed
The shooting range holds 42 challenges, each with a gold medal band

actions.t: Finish Gone Fishing and learn the partner-switch controls before free roaming
Take the Ocean Beach cocktail stop as soon as the map opens; it is free progress
Meditate on the Chapter 1 balcony the first time the game offers it
Make a manual save in a fresh slot at the end of the chapter
Tick off any activity type you touch; the sampler trophy counts first tries
Note every meditation spot you pass, even ones you skip, for the cleanup pass
Complete the chapter missions in order and keep one save before the heist
Start a stranger strand whenever a question mark appears near a mission start
Begin the collectible card habit: check each new interior before leaving it
Try the shooting range once to learn the gold scoring bands early
Register any story-gifted vehicle in the Scooter Bros app right away
Keep the Trust mission partner alive through its final chase
Clear the chapter missions and photograph any new animal species you meet
Enter every drone race location you unlock; wins count per location, not per race
Rob your first illegal operation for each gang as territories open up
Bank cash steadily toward the spending and laundering totals; do not sit on marked bills
Finish two full card sets by sweeping the chapter 3 interiors
Make a fresh manual save before the VCIA mission sequence starts
Finish the chapter missions and close out any stranger strand still open
Gold the shooting range challenges while your weapon unlocks are complete
Push race wins toward twenty, mixing vehicle classes so wins stay different
Complete the third card set before the finale locks some interiors
Sweep meditation spots in the northern half of Leonida now
Save in two slots before starting the final mission chain
Play the final mission on the save you prepared; do not overwrite it mid-chain
Take the partner escape route for the four-star trophy if it has not popped
Watch for the second-try and strange-event moments; both are scripted here
Let the credits finish; several totals only tally after the finale resolves
Immediately save the post-story state in its own slot
Check the trophy list against this tracker before starting cleanup
Finish every stranger strand, including the final missions for each contact
Grind the counted trophies with the in-app counters: stunts, WAiNK spots, vehicles
Rob the five bank vaults and the armored truck, escaping cleanly each time
Explore the last unvisited areas of Leonida district by district
Buy the remaining garage properties as cash allows
Launder marked bills through contacts until the quarter-million total is reached
Work the 100 percent checklist category by category, not trophy by trophy
Finish the challenge list; the trophy needs fifty but the checklist counts more
Complete any remaining stunt locations so both the trophy and checklist agree
Confirm the meditation total in the stats menu before the final sweep
Spend the last of the shopping total across small shops to top up the counter
Let A Long Road pop, then the platinum follows automatically
